dc_description_s: This data represents streets for the City of Oshkosh, Wisconsin in 2026. [Overview This data provides a current streets inventory for the City of Oshkosh area, capturing roadway segment information and associated pavement, surface, and route characteristics. It supports roadway management, inventory tracking, and street condition review within a local transportation GIS workflow. Current Streets Inventory: A street centerline inventory layer that stores roadway segment attributes such as street name, section limits, segment length, pavement and surface condition, construction and surface year, surface type, curb and right-of-way details, traffic volume, routing references, treatment information, and other maintenance and engineering notes. The layer also includes standard editor tracking fields for data stewardship. Geographic Coverage: The service covers a local municipal street network in the Oshkosh area and is configured for use in city-scale transportation and asset management applications. Use Cases: Street inventory and roadway asset management, Pavement and surface condition tracking, Transportation planning and maintenance documentation, Reference for route, section, and segment-based street records.]
uw_supplemental_s: This is an archived copy of the data held at UW-Madison.
